points_to_position — REPRCONV keypoint op

• Data kinds: points → position

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.points_to_position(points) (to call the implementation directly, import reprconv; reprconv.points_to_position(points); from the registry, opsreprconv.get("points_to_position"))

Usage

A point set (N,3) → its centroid (z, y, x). Not invertible (the distribution is thrown away).

The amount discarded can be measured: the RMS distance around the centroid is exactly "the spread lost by collapsing to 1 point", and selftest reports it numerically. Only when N = 1 is the round trip with position_to_points bit-identical.

Args:

points: (N, 3) (z, y, x).

Returns:

a 3-tuple of float (z, y, x).

Raises:

ValueError: invalid shape / non-finite.
